column5: Nineteen pull requests. Four hours, forty-three minutes. Watch.
PR one. The iPhone app. Feed, reels, ranking.
Then messages, notifications, and native reels.
Stories! Comments! Like a real app.
Next, a server. Written in Rust. Obviously.
Repost. Collab tardies. A share sheet.
Uh oh. Two videos playing at once.
Then six PRs in seventy-eight seconds.
Tap-backs. Share to your agents. Video at its real shape.
